faqs.question: What is your commission rate?
faqs.answer: Our standard commission rate is 5-6% of the sale price, split between the buyer's and seller's agents. We're happy to discuss our fee structure in detail during a consultation. For first-time buyers, we offer a complimentary buyer consultation at no obligation.

faqs.question: Do you work with first-time home buyers?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We love working with first-time buyers. We'll guide you through every step of the process, from getting pre-approved for a mortgage to closing day. We can also connect you with lenders who offer first-time buyer programs with lower down payment requirements.

faqs.question: Can you help with both buying and selling?
faqs.answer: Yes, we handle both buy-side and sell-side transactions. If you need to sell your current home before purchasing a new one, we can coordinate the timing of both transactions to make the transition as smooth as possible. We also offer bridge financing referrals if needed.

faqs.question: How do I schedule a showing?
faqs.answer: You can schedule a showing by replying to this message with your preferred date and time, or by calling our office directly. We typically offer showings 7 days a week between 9 AM and 7 PM. Virtual tours are also available for most of our listings.

faqs.question: What is the average price per square foot in Greenwood?
faqs.answer: The average price per square foot in the Greenwood area is currently around $175-$195, depending on the property condition and specific location within the neighborhood. This has increased approximately 8% over the past year.

faqs.question: What neighborhoods do you recommend for downsizers?
faqs.answer: For downsizers looking for single-story, low-maintenance living, we recommend the Lakeside area (great condo options with amenities), Westfield (established neighborhood with smaller ranch homes), and the newer townhouse developments in Greenwood. Each offers walkability and proximity to shopping and healthcare.

faqs.question: Do you have pet-friendly listings?
faqs.answer: Many of our listings are pet-friendly! For homes with fenced yards suitable for larger dogs, we have several options in Greenwood, Westfield, and Pine Ridge. For condos and townhouses, pet policies vary by HOA — we can filter our listings based on your specific pet needs.

faqs.question: What are HOA fees and what do they cover?
faqs.answer: HOA (Homeowners Association) fees vary by community. They typically cover exterior maintenance, common area upkeep, amenities like pools and fitness centers, and sometimes utilities like water and trash. Our condo listings range from $200-$425/month in HOA fees. We always provide a full breakdown of what's included.

faqs.question: Can you help with rental properties?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can assist with finding rental properties as well as purchase opportunities. If you're relocating and need a rental first while you search for a home to buy, we can help coordinate both. We have access to rental listings across all our service areas.

faqs.question: What should I do if the inspection reveals problems?
faqs.answer: If an inspection reveals issues, you have several options depending on your contract terms: 1) Request the seller make repairs before closing, 2) Negotiate a price reduction to account for repair costs, 3) Request a seller credit at closing, or 4) Exercise your inspection contingency to walk away. We'll advise you on the best approach based on the severity of the issues and current market conditions.

faqs.question: How long does the home buying process take?
faqs.answer: From the time your offer is accepted, closing typically takes 30-45 days. The full process from initial search to closing can vary widely — some buyers find their home in a week, others take several months. Getting pre-approved before you start looking can speed things up significantly.

faqs.question: What is a cap rate and why does it matter?
faqs.answer: Cap rate (capitalization rate) is a key metric for investment properties. It's calculated by dividing the property's net operating income by its purchase price. A higher cap rate generally indicates a higher potential return but may also come with higher risk. In our area, cap rates for multi-family properties typically range from 5-7%.

faqs.question: Are there properties near the new metro station?
faqs.answer: Yes! The new metro station being built on 5th Avenue is expected to be completed in 2025. We have several listings within walking distance, including new construction condos at 820 5th Avenue. Properties near transit hubs historically see strong appreciation — this is a great time to invest in the area.

faqs.question: What school districts do your listings cover?
faqs.answer: Our listings span several school districts. Notable ones include Lincoln Elementary (serving the Lincoln District and parts of Greenwood), Westfield Academy (serving Westfield and surrounding areas), and Downtown Charter School. We can filter listings by specific school district upon request.

faqs.question: How do I get pre-approved for a mortgage?
faqs.answer: We recommend getting pre-approved before you start your home search. We work with several trusted lenders who can help. The process typically requires proof of income, employment verification, credit check, and bank statements. Pre-approval usually takes 1-3 business days and gives you a clear budget to work with.

faqs.question: What is the listing process for selling my home?
faqs.answer: Our listing process includes: 1) Free home valuation with comparable market analysis, 2) Discuss pricing strategy and timeline, 3) Sign listing agreement, 4) Professional photography and staging consultation, 5) List on MLS and market across social media and our network, 6) Manage showings and open houses, 7) Negotiate offers and guide you through closing.

faqs.question: Do you offer virtual tours?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer virtual tours for most of our active listings. You can view them on our website or request a private virtual walkthrough via video call. This is especially helpful for out-of-town buyers or for an initial screening before scheduling an in-person visit.

faqs.question: What are closing costs and how much should I expect?
faqs.answer: Closing costs typically range from 2-5% of the purchase price for buyers and 6-10% for sellers (including agent commissions). Buyer costs include loan origination fees, appraisal, title insurance, and escrow fees. We provide a detailed estimate early in the process so there are no surprises.

faqs.question: Can I make an offer below asking price?
faqs.answer: You can make an offer at any price. Whether a below-asking offer is advisable depends on market conditions, how long the property has been listed, comparable sales, and the property's condition. We'll provide a competitive market analysis to help you determine a strong offer price.

faqs.question: What commercial spaces do you have available?
faqs.answer: We currently have commercial spaces available in the Downtown area, including a 2,200 sq ft corner space at Market Square that's ideal for restaurant use with existing hood ventilation and grease trap. We can also search our network for additional commercial listings based on your specific requirements.
